description: This file defines the IPRange class, which provides static methods to check if an IP address (IPv4 or IPv6) matches a given CIDR range. It includes functions for matching IPv4 and IPv6 addresses using subnet masks.

classes.name: IPRange
classes.description: A utility class with static methods for matching IP addresses against CIDR ranges.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Determines whether the given IP address matches the specified CIDR range, dispatching to IPv4 or IPv6 specific methods.

methods.name: matchesIPv4
methods.description: Checks if an IPv4 address matches a CIDR range.

methods.name: matchesIPv6
methods.description: Checks if an IPv6 address matches a CIDR range.
